title: 原生角色 × 工作图 × 验收闭环
code: integration/native-managed.js — bind claims the node and records the owning child; settle applies the durable execution verdict; acceptance evidence is the only path to completing a node
src/index.js — coharness native_action bind|settle|coverage; the node carries the native task id so the bridge books under it

bindClaimsNode.observed: claim records taskId and childId; re-binding the same session is idempotent

executionDoesNotDeliver.observed: execution completed without evidence leaves the node running, acceptance pending, delivered false, dependants locked

evidenceUnlocksDependants.observed: with evidence the node completes, acceptance passes, and the dependent becomes ready only then

failedExecutionReleases.observed: failed execution releases the claim to failed and never delivers

noEarlySettle.observed: settling a running task is refused (OMC/NATIVE-MANAGED-RUNNING)

staleAttemptRefused.observed: an attempt id that is not the current attempt is refused (OMC/NATIVE-MANAGED-STALE-ATTEMPT)

singleWriter.observed: a second writer in an overlapping scope is refused by the graph claim

unmanagedStaysUnmanaged.observed: a native child nobody bound stays unbound and the coverage report says unmanaged work is possible

toolLevelHostProbe.observed: through the mounted coharness tool on a real host: graph plan -> bind a native child -> settle without evidence stays pending -> settle with evidence delivers and completes the node; 0 model calls

boundaries: OMC binds an existing native child; it does not start one on the host's behalf. A child nobody bound is not retroactively claimed
the graph claim is a coordination constraint, not a file permission
a completed execution with no evidence is reported as pending acceptance, never as delivered
notCovered: a real Explorer -> Fixer -> acceptance run with live models
external Codex -> native Fixer mixed chain
